limits: The existing arg(flag, fallback) helper in src/cli.mjs (L15-L19) only returns process.argv[i + 1] when it is truthy and does not start with '--'; if --oracle-results is passed as the final argv token without a value, followed immediately by another '--' flag, given an empty string, given a path starting with '--', or passed in '--oracle-results=FILE' form, arg() silently falls back to undefined rather than raising a CLI usage error. Also, process.argv.indexOf(flag) selects the first match if the flag is repeated.

src/cli.mjs performs pure string forwarding for --oracle-results without path normalization or existence checks; relative paths are resolved later by readFileSync(oracleResultsPath, 'utf8') in compile-custody.mjs (L312) relative to the process current working directory at call time.

compile-custody-cli-args.test.mjs supplies explicit CLI flags for all eight non-oracle inputs (--source, --seed, --cases, --expected-release, --expected-refund, --residual, --manifest, --out), so the hardcoded fallback paths in src/cli.mjs (L300-L313) and the usage() output text (L52) are verified by static inspection rather than runtime assertions in this test file.

This source change is strictly limited to CLI argument handoff for --oracle-results; it does not modify or establish compiler correctness, oracle content/trust validation, Q1 security properties, EUC-012/EUC-013 publication or generated-spend requirements, or native/ledger execution.

The five-test execution is a scoped unit/regression run for CLI argument transport using module-resolution capture probes; compileCustody itself, Aiken, UPLC compilation, oracle file reading/parsing, bindOracleSpends, and native/SDK/ledger consumers did not execute.

Because ./native-runtime.mjs was also replaced by a pass-through probe (resolveOutputPath returning { ok: true, path: path ?? fallback }), output-path policy validation (such as refusing historical campaign check directories) was not exercised in these test runs.

When --oracle-results is omitted, the test verifies that options.oracleResultsPath is of type 'undefined' at the compileCustody call boundary; actual binding to DEFAULT_ORACLE and reading of that path depend on the unchanged compile-custody.mjs parameter default (L202) and read site (L312), which were not executed during the probed run.
The usage() help string update in src/cli.mjs (L52) is verified by static source inspection of the embedded file rather than a runtime test case triggering the usage() stderr exit path.

Cleanup receipts (ownedSessionRemaining: [] and existsAfter: false) attest only to the owned session (800143) and ownedRoot (/tmp/doctorwatson-custody-cli-args-cqi6sgh2); they do not prove system-wide unrelated-process or syscall exclusion, and no EUC-012/EUC-013, Q1 security, oracle-trust, or financial/native admission gate is satisfied or altered by this result.
